_comment: Hand-curated sideboard hoser catalog for Legacy. Each entry maps to a HoserCard in advisory/sideboard.py. swing: 'dedicated' = 0.20, 'soft' = 0.10. colors: WUBRG single-char list; empty = colorless. castable_any_color: true bypasses the color pre-filter (Phyrexian mana, free-activation abilities). symmetry: 'asymmetric' (default; hits only the opponent/their stuff, incl. the caster choosing a target) or 'symmetric' (the effect's own text applies with no owner restriction, so it can hit the caster too). functional_group: identical-effect group key; at most one card per group contributes coverage (see _build_coverage_model de-dup).

hosers.name: Surgical Extraction
hosers._comment: Phyrexian mana: castable for 2 life in any deck regardless of color identity. Exiles all copies of one chosen card — denies recurring/casting that specific reanimation target.

hosers.name: Faerie Macabre
hosers._comment: Free discard activation: usable at zero mana cost in any deck. Exiles up to two chosen cards from graveyards — narrow, targeted; denies specific recursion targets.

hosers.name: Leyline of the Void
hosers._comment: Exiles every card that would go to an OPPONENT's graveyard going forward — denies both recursion targets and graveyard-as-fuel accumulation (delve/threshold) for that opponent.

hosers.name: Endurance
hosers._comment: Flash creature; puts a chosen player's entire graveyard on the bottom of their library — a one-shot full reset that denies both recursion targets and fuel count for that player.

hosers.name: Containment Priest
hosers._comment: 'If a nontoken creature would enter and it wasn't cast, exile it instead' has no owner restriction — it also exiles the controller's OWN reanimation/cheat-into-play targets, so it self-hoses a deck that itself reanimates.

hosers.name: Grafdigger's Cage
hosers._comment: Colorless artifact — always castable. 'Players can't cast spells from graveyards or libraries' has no owner restriction — stops ALL players, so it self-hoses a graveyard-recursion deck's own plan (Nethergoyf/Flow-State-style shells).

hosers.name: Nihil Spellbomb
hosers._comment: Corrected mis-color (catalog-lint finding, feature-data-autonomy-catalog-lint): colorless artifact, mana_cost {1} — the {B} is an optional draw-a-card activation cost when it dies, not part of its cast cost. Sacrifice: exile a chosen player's entire graveyard — a one-shot full reset like Endurance, denying both recursion targets and fuel count for the targeted player.

hosers.name: Dauthi Voidwalker
hosers._comment: Exiles cards from an OPPONENT's graveyard as they go there, ongoing — denies both recursion and fuel accumulation for that opponent; creature body provides additional pressure.

hosers.name: Consign to Memory
hosers._comment: Oracle (DB-verified 2026-07-03): 'Replicate {1}' + 'Counter target triggered ability or colorless spell.' Counters COLORLESS spells and TRIGGERED ABILITIES only — not a general counterspell. Premier vs storm triggers (storm is a triggered ability), Saga chapter triggers, Chalice triggers, and colorless (Eldrazi/artifact) spells; replicate {1} scales to multiple triggers in one turn. 'colorless-reliant' (feature-sfv-colorless-axis) attaches the colorless-spell half of this text to the mechanics-derived colorless-nonland-spell-density axis (whattoplay._vulnerability_from_composition); the triggered-ability half is not separately attached — a companion 'trigger-reliant' axis was evaluated and declined as not cleanly composition-derivable (see whattoplay.VulnerabilityTag docstring).

hosers.name: Force of Negation
hosers._comment: feature-sfv-attachments: 'you may exile a blue card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost' (free on the opponent's turn) — 'Counter target noncreature spell.' Attacks noncreature-reliant (the broad-interaction axis) in addition to combo/storm-reliant so it credits the whole combo/control plurality it answers, not just tiny combo elements.

hosers.name: Spell Pierce
hosers._comment: feature-sfv-attachments: 'Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {2}.' Soft (taxing, not a hard counter) anti-noncreature answer — attacks noncreature-reliant alongside combo/storm-reliant, same broad-interaction attribution as Force of Negation but at _SWING_SOFT.

hosers.name: Veil of Summer
hosers._comment: Counter-hoser: defends the deck against opposing interaction. Text is self-referential ('you'/'permanents you control') — beneficial only to the caster.

hosers.name: Defense Grid
hosers._comment: Colorless artifact — counter-hoser. 'Each spell costs {3} more except during its controller's turn' has no owner restriction — the caster's own instant-speed spells on the opponent's turn cost more too.

hosers.name: Carpet of Flowers
hosers._comment: Counter-hoser. Mana ability triggers off an opponent's Islands and adds mana only for the caster — beneficial only to the caster.

hosers.name: Blood Moon
hosers._comment: 'Nonbasic lands are Mountains' has no owner restriction — it also turns the caster's own nonbasic lands into Mountains, self-hosing a nonbasic-heavy deck.

hosers.name: Back to Basics
hosers._comment: 'Nonbasic lands don't untap during their controllers' untap steps' has no owner restriction — self-hoses a nonbasic-heavy caster (already the anti-synergy filter's basis for blocking it).

hosers.name: Wasteland
hosers._comment: Colorless land — always legal. Destroys a chosen nonbasic land; the caster picks the target.

hosers.name: Force of Vigor
hosers._comment: Answers Blood Moon / Back to Basics / Chalice. Destroys up to two chosen artifacts/enchantments — the caster picks the targets.

hosers.name: Krosan Grip
hosers._comment: Destroys a chosen artifact or enchantment — the caster picks the target.

hosers.name: Pyroblast
hosers._comment: Corrected mis-tag (was combo/low-interaction). 'Counter target spell if it's blue' / 'Destroy target permanent if it's blue' — counters/destroys BLUE, functionally identical to Red Elemental Blast.

hosers.name: Hydroblast
hosers._comment: Corrected mis-tag (was greedy-manabase/low-interaction). 'Counter target spell if it's red' / 'Destroy target permanent if it's red' — counters/destroys RED, functionally identical to Blue Elemental Blast.

hosers.name: Blue Elemental Blast
hosers._comment: Added (was previously only reachable via empirical promotion with a generic fallback tag). 'Counter target red spell' / 'Destroy target red permanent' — functionally identical to Hydroblast.

hosers.name: Red Elemental Blast
hosers._comment: Added. 'Counter target blue spell' / 'Destroy target blue permanent' — functionally identical to Pyroblast.

hosers.name: Mystical Dispute
hosers._comment: feature-sfv-attachments: 'This spell costs {2} less to cast if it targets a blue spell. Counter target spell unless its controller pays {3}.' plays-blue-contingent — a generic soft counter that is cheap and effective specifically against a blue-heavy field, matching the Pyroblast/Red Elemental Blast attachment convention rather than the noncreature-reliant axis (it targets ANY spell, not specifically noncreature ones).

hosers.name: Chalice of the Void
hosers._comment: Colorless artifact — always castable. 'Whenever A PLAYER casts a spell with mana value equal to X' has no owner restriction — counters the caster's own spells at that cost too. Anti-synergy: blocked for low-curve decks.

hosers.name: Engineered Explosives
hosers._comment: Colorless artifact; sunburst lets it answer permanents at any CMC. 'Destroy EACH nonland permanent with mana value equal to X' has no owner restriction — hits the caster's own permanents at that cost too.

hosers.name: Sheoldred's Edict
hosers._comment: 'Each OPPONENT sacrifices...' is explicitly opponent-scoped — bypasses hexproof/indestructible, hits creature-based strategies.

hosers.name: Toxic Deluge
hosers._comment: One-sided in name only — 'ALL creatures get -X/-X' has no owner restriction, so it can wipe the caster's own board too. Bypasses indestructible; scales CMC to handle any size threats.

hosers.name: Harbinger of the Seas
hosers._comment: 'Nonbasic lands are Islands' has no owner restriction — locks Tron/Cloudpost out of their mana, but also turns the caster's own nonbasic lands into Islands.

hosers.name: Damping Sphere
hosers._comment: Colorless artifact. Both clauses are explicitly per-player ('a land', 'a player has cast') with no owner restriction — hoses Tron/Post mana AND storm chains for BOTH players, including the caster.

hosers.name: Pithing Needle
hosers._comment: Colorless artifact. 'Activated abilities of sources with the chosen name' has no owner restriction — if the caster runs a namesake, it locks their own copy too. Names Eye of Ugin / Eldrazi Temple activated abilities; staxes planeswalkers and utility lands.

hosers.name: Null Rod
hosers._comment: 'Activated abilities of artifacts can't be activated' has no owner restriction — shuts down mana artifacts (Mox Diamond, Chrome Mox, Grim Monolith) for the caster too if their own deck runs them.
